phase3.p304.criteria: The existing Class XI mixed rehearsal paper takes 90 minutes, with eighteen five-minute units and five groups worth twenty marks each. It covers two tank models, a canal-log explanation, a bicycle-lamp fault and a titration group report. Survey and allocation are optional. Answer with the methods, confirmation and bounded claims offered by the paper. Diagnostic academic marks are separate from tower rank.
phase3.p304.recovery: Retrieve an issued assignment from the study desk academic record, including after an absence. You may begin or restart it after the disclosed deadline. Its original deadline stays visible, and late submission carries a separate label with the same diagnostic marking rules. Submission spends 90 world minutes. Cancelling discards the draft and spends its used five-minute units.
